purpose: Test one parameter-free equal-Fourier-band denoising objective after the rejected trilinear representation change, without post-hoc tuning or independent-data access.

parent_evidence.scientific_baseline: V15-E3 nearest decoder; E4 trilinear is rejected rather than inherited

e5_band_balanced_denoising.single_change_from_v15_e3: replace L=(U+T)/2 by L=(U+T+B)/3; retain the nearest decoder and every other E3 model, optimizer, data, and sampler setting

loss.edm_weight: w=(sigma^2+sigma_data^2)/(sigma*sigma_data)^2, applied per sample to U, T, and B
loss.U: mean squared e over channel and all N^3 voxels
loss.T: sum(e^2 * frozen train-only density-tail voxel weights) / sum(weights), unchanged from E3
loss.B: full-complex FFT of float32 e with norm=ortho; within each non-DC Fourier band take mean |e_hat|^2 per channel and mode, then take the equal mean of four bands

e5_band_balanced_denoising.seed_rationale: reuse the E4 seeds because B consumes no RNG, preserving paired training-noise and sampling-noise comparisons against the nearest E3 baseline without a result-conditioned seed change
e5_band_balanced_denoising.selection: smallest candidate passing all unchanged V6 field checks in all three development domains

report_only_all_band_diagnostic.quantity: generated total power divided by truth total power
report_only_all_band_diagnostic.falsifiable_prediction: relative to nearest E3 at the same step and paired seed, TNG 1-3 and 3-6 ratios move toward unity

fixed_decision_order: implement and train E5 exactly as declared
evaluate candidates in ascending order 5000 then 10000 using the unchanged V6 field gate on all three development domains
if E5 passes, stop development and create a new one-file committed Astrid seal before any independent-data access
if E5 makes TNG and SIMBA pass and leaves only the Swift peak/void check failing, stop unopened and predeclare the already reserved all-band target-free conditional-scale experiment
for every other E5 failure pattern, stop without opening Astrid and obtain a new independent design audit; do not tune loss coefficients or band weights

pre_execution_correction.reason: The initial registry incorrectly copied the future 25 Mpc/h Astrid inference grid of 80^3 into the development-loss metadata. All six TNG/SIMBA/Swift training and validation caches are bit-identical 64^3 grids at 0.3125 Mpc/h (20 Mpc/h cubes).
pre_execution_correction.failed_attempt_stage: cache grid invariant check before output-directory creation, model construction, optimizer construction, RNG draws, or optimizer updates
pre_execution_correction.scientific_changes: none; Fourier edges, loss coefficients, model, seeds, subsets, sampler, thresholds, and decision order are unchanged

independent_audit.conclusion: Reject trilinear, return to the E3 nearest baseline, and add exactly one equal-band Fourier denoising term with U/T/B equal weights.
